copy.tagline_en: Follow a test-driven development workflow to complete development tasks in phases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to follow a strict test-driven workflow in your development tasks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Conductor 的 TDD 流程实现任务：先写失败的测试，再实现并重构，处理阶段检查点、git 提交和 notes，并把进度写回 plan.md。
howto.when: 当你按某条 track 的 plan.md 实现任务、走 TDD 红-绿-重构循环，或要处理阶段检查点与 git 提交等时触发。

say.text: 按 TDD 开始实现 plan.md 里的下一个任务
say.note: 先写失败测试再写实现

say.text: 帮我完成当前阶段的检查点
给刚做完的任务写 git 提交和 notes

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows Conductor's TDD workflow: write a failing test first, then implement and refactor, handle phase checkpoints, git commits and notes, and record progress back in plan.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement tasks from a track's plan.md, follow the TDD red-green-refactor cycle, or handle phase checkpoints and git commits for tasks.

say_en.text: Implement the next task in plan.md using TDD
Complete the phase checkpoint for this phase
Write the git commit and notes for the task I just finished
